note: Read-only. The saved model artifacts are scored, never retrained or overwritten.

AXI.reading: The defensible model. Small test set (n=96), so per-class figures carry wide intervals.

OULAD.WARNING: This accuracy is INFLATED BY TARGET LEAKAGE. A Pass_rate feature derived from the outcome leaked into training, so the model is largely reading the answer rather than predicting it. It must NOT be presented as reliable early risk prediction.

leakage_diagnostic: scripts/evaluate_models.py prints mean Pass_rate by final_result, which demonstrates the leak directly.

training_serving_parity.issue_found_and_fixed: Days_Active was computed as max(date) during training but as a count of distinct days at inference.

pinned_versions.reason: Matches the version the .joblib artifacts were pickled with; a mismatch risks silently wrong predictions.
